_doc: Find Me Money's content settings. Every outlet waits on a brand account the owner creates or names; the bot never signs in or creates an account. Publishing is the owner's yes.
voice: one person talking to a phone camera: first person, present tense
the receipt on screen in the first three seconds
every piece teaches one thing the viewer can use that day
funny, simple, relatable: a laugh or a stopped scroll (the eight money hooks)
no promise of approval, an amount, a rate or a timeline
no link and no 'DM me' in a public reply
never names a company as a wrongdoer; sender names stay covered

linkedin.publisher: off: this business has no LinkedIn lane
linkedin.waits_on: a brand account the owner creates or names

youtube.publisher: the owner (uploads stay private until they publish)
youtube.waits_on: a brand account the owner creates or names
youtube.note: the strongest lever on record: the AEO baseline found AI answers cite YouTube on most of the funding questions and this site on none; one video per guide question, with the existing answer pages as the scripts' source

newsletter.waits_on: a list to send to and a published workflow (publishing a workflow is the owner's yes); no audience exists yet

instagram.publisher: the owner or a named poster
instagram.waits_on: a brand account the owner creates or names

facebook.publisher: undecided: the owner's 2026-11-07 ruling on hired posters covers answering asks, not publishing content
facebook.waits_on: a brand account the owner creates or names

existing: find-me-money role content: three scored pieces a day and a weekly batch of ten
a newsletter workflow in the CRM, by name in the pack's intake values
gaps: the four formats are not named; the pack has hooks, not formats
drafting runs on the bot, not Claude Code
who posts on each outlet is undecided (the pack's own checklist asks)
no brand account is on record for any outlet
no newsletter audience or live workflow
who publishes content on Facebook is undecided

tools._doc: The toolset is per campaign: switch each on or off, and name whose account it runs on. Every one of these is a paid tool with its own plan or credits; a sign-up and a render are spend, and spend needs the owner's yes. weekly_limit is the most the tool may spend in a week, in the tool's own unit, such as '20 USD' or '2000 credits'; it is on the owner's keep-or-remove list in STATUS.md.

message: campaigns/find-me-money/MESSAGING.md: the position, the eight education pillars, the content types. The full messaging document, its proof points and its claims list are private and given at intake (context/messaging/).
series: the owner's own story, serialised: drafted only from the private messaging document, once he has cleared its claims list
_pieces: A default from Justin's 2026-11-24 words ("creating content, really more so than anything else"; "really double down on content"): three in the morning run, three in the afternoon run. He changes it by saying a number.
